name: lastfm
description: Last.fm music data integration — look up artist info, similar artists, and top tracks, search tracks, browse tag and global charts, and read a user's recent plays and top artists. Uses a free Last.fm API key (read-only public methods, no scrobbling). Attribution required: music data is provided by Last.fm and the Last.fm API is for non-commercial use.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Music metadata, charts, and listening history via the Last.fm API

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Create a free Last.fm API account to get an API key.

fields.label: Default Username
fields.helpText: Optional Last.fm username used by the user.* tools when no username is given.

tools.name: lastfm.get_artist_info
tools.description: Get info about an artist: bio summary, listener and play counts, top tags, and Last.fm URL.

tools.name: lastfm.get_similar_artists
tools.description: List artists similar to a given artist, with match scores and Last.fm URLs.

artist.description: Artist name to find similar artists for

tools.name: lastfm.get_artist_top_tracks
tools.description: List an artist's most popular tracks on Last.fm with play and listener counts.

tools.name: lastfm.search_tracks
tools.description: Search Last.fm for tracks by name. Returns track name, artist, listeners, and Last.fm URL.

tools.name: lastfm.get_tag_top_artists
tools.description: List the top artists for a genre tag (e.g. shoegaze, jazz) on Last.fm.

tools.name: lastfm.get_chart_top_artists
tools.description: List the current global top-chart artists on Last.fm.

tools.name: lastfm.get_user_recent_tracks
tools.description: List a user's recently played tracks (name, artist, date, or now playing). Falls back to the connection's default_username when no username is given.

username.description: Last.fm username (defaults to the connection's default_username)

tools.name: lastfm.get_user_top_artists
tools.description: List a user's top artists for a period. Falls back to the connection's default_username when no username is given.

username.description: Last.fm username (defaults to the connection's default_username)
